{{Top|leg}}
'''''T-SF''''' was a group of three [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]]s used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. The tugs were to deliver pilots to [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], while their sister group ''[[T-SE]]'' did the same to shuttles ''[[Revt]]'' to defend a supply depot conisting of three [[Class-A cargo container|containers]] ''[[Duce]]'' from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces intending to destroy everything. The two [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transports]] ''[[Bultz]]'' powered up to provide cover, but the battle ended in favor of the Empire and the tugs were destroyed in the battle along with everything else. The battle was then recreated and adapted in the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]] such as [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
